text: For two videos, we dropped Oog into your world.
scene: {CAVE} shocked on a highway with cars [TIMER 4 SEC]

text: Now it's your turn.
scene: {GUY} shocked in the snow at night, an exclamation mark

text: You wake up forty thousand years ago, next to Oog.
scene: {GUY} confused and {CAVE} smiling in a cave, a stone tablet with "40000"

text: No phone. No shoes. No idea what's going on.
scene: {GUY} terrified in a cave, the word "NO PHONE" above him

text: Oog looks at you the way you'd look at a lost puppy.
scene: {CAVE} smug next to {GUY} confused in a cave, the word "PUPPY" above him

text: Soft hands. Clean teeth. Funny clothes.
scene: {CAVE} thinking next to {GUY} smiling in a cave, the word "SOFT" above them

text: We'll put you through nine parts of Oog's world and start the timer.
scene: {GUY} confused in a cave, a clock [TIMER 0:00]

text: In one, you last all night.
scene: {GUY} asleep by a campfire in a cave at night, z letters [TIMER ALL NIGHT]

text: In another, about four seconds.
scene: {GUY} terrified, a lion angry in the snow, an exclamation mark [TIMER 4 SEC]

text: And the thing that would actually keep you alive
scene: {GUY} confused in a cave, a big question mark

text: isn't a spear, or a fire.
scene: {CAVE} smiling, holding a spear, by a campfire in a cave, a big red X

text: Here are the rules.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "RULES" above him

text: You're a normal modern adult.
scene: {SCI} proud next to {GUY} smiling, a chalkboard

text: Same species as Oog, same brain.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "SAME" above him

text: But you've never hunted, never made fire, and never walked barefoot more than to the fridge.
scene: {GUY} smug on a couch in a living room, the word "FRIDGE" above him

text: The timer stops when you're in serious trouble,
scene: {GUY} terrified in the snow at night, an exclamation mark

text: or when Oog has to come and save you.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, next to {GUY} relieved in the snow

text: From the longest to the shortest. Good luck.
scene: {GUY} confused in a forest, a clock [TIMER 0:00]

text: First: a night in Oog's cave, with his whole group.
scene: {GUY} smiling by a campfire in a cave at night, the word "CAVE" above him

text: And honestly? You'd be fine.
scene: {GUY} happy by a campfire in a cave at night, sparkles

text: There's a fire.
scene: a campfire in a cave at night, the word "FIRE" above it

text: There are furs to sleep on.
scene: {GUY} happy, asleep in a cave at night, z letters

text: Everyone sleeps close together, for warmth and for safety.
scene: three Hadza hunters asleep by a campfire at night, z letters, hearts

text: And someone is always awake.
scene: {CAVE} thinking by a campfire in a cave at night, the moon

text: Remember the Hadza sleep study?
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "HADZA" above him

text: Over more than two hundred hours of nights,
scene: three Hadza hunters asleep at night, z letters

text: the whole group was asleep at the same time for only eighteen minutes.
scene: {SCI} shocked at a chalkboard, the word "18 MIN" above him

text: Older people slept early, younger people stayed up late.
scene: an old woman asleep and a Hadza hunter thinking by a campfire at night, z letters

text: It's like a free night shift.
scene: {CAVE} proud by a campfire in a cave at night, the word "NIGHT SHIFT" above him

text: Your only job is to not wander off in the dark to find a toilet.
scene: {GUY} confused in a cave at night, the word "TOILET" above him, a big red X

text: So you sleep. You snore. Nobody eats you.
scene: {GUY} asleep by a campfire in a cave at night, z letters, hearts

text: Timer: all night.
scene: {GUY} happy in a cave, sparkles [TIMER ALL NIGHT]

text: Morning. The group is moving to a new camp.
scene: {CAVE} happy, holding a spear, in a forest, the word "MOVE" above him

text: Ten kilometers. Barefoot.
scene: {GUY} shocked in a forest, the word "10 KM" above him

text: Over stones, roots, thorns and frozen mud.
scene: {GUY} terrified in a forest, the word "THORNS" above him

text: Oog doesn't even look down. He's busy watching for animals.
scene: {CAVE} smug, holding a spear, in a forest, the word "WATCH" above him

text: You look down at every single step.
scene: {GUY} sweating in a forest, the word "STEP" above him

text: Hunter-gatherers often walk that far in a day, and many don't wear shoes at all.
scene: a Hadza hunter proud on a savanna, the word "BAREFOOT" above him

text: Their secret is thick calluses.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "CALLUSES" above him

text: In a 2019 study, people who usually walk barefoot had calluses about thirty percent thicker.
scene: {SCI} proud at a chalkboard, the word "30%" above him

text: And those thick soles didn't make their feet any less sensitive.
scene: {SCI} smiling at a chalkboard, sparkles

text: Shoes are still better at keeping feet warm, though. Calluses don't do that.
scene: {SCI} thinking at a chalkboard, the word "WARM" above him

text: Your feet, on the other hand, are soft. Like bread.
scene: {GUY} sad in a forest, the word "BREAD" above him

text: After two hours, you're limping.
scene: {GUY} sad, sweating, in a forest, the word "OUCH" above him

text: Oog carries you the rest of the way.
scene: {CAVE} proud next to {GUY} sad in a forest, the word "CARRY" above them

text: Timer: two hours.
scene: {GUY} sad in a forest [TIMER 2 HOURS]

text: Next job: gathering food.
scene: {GUY} happy in a forest, a berry bush, the word "FOOD" above him

text: In many hunter-gatherer groups, gathered plants were a big part of the diet.
scene: {WOMAN} smiling in a forest, a berry bush, the word "PLANTS" above her

text: There's a bush full of shiny berries.
scene: {GUY} happy in a forest, a berry bush, sparkles

text: Some are food. Some can make you very sick.
scene: {SCI} thinking at a chalkboard, the word "SICK" above him

text: Oog's group learned the difference from the time they were kids.
scene: {WOMAN} smiling and a baby {CAVE} happy in a forest, a berry bush

text: You learned it from... nobody.
scene: {GUY} confused in a forest, a berry bush, a big question mark

text: You eat the shiniest ones.
scene: {GUY} happy eating in a forest, a berry bush

text: Oog's face says everything.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a forest, an exclamation mark

text: Here's a strange bonus fact while you recover.
scene: {SCI} smiling in a lab, a light bulb above him

text: Skeletons from before farming tend to have far fewer cavities than those of early farmers.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "CAVITIES" above him

text: Lots of starchy, sticky grain came later.
scene: a farmer smiling in a village, the word "GRAIN" above him

text: So Oog's teeth may look rough, but they're probably in better shape than you'd expect.
scene: {CAVE} happy, smiling in a cave, sparkles, the word "TEETH" above him

text: Timer: one hour, and a very bad stomach ache.
scene: {GUY} sad, sweating, in a forest, the word "OUCH" above him [TIMER 1 HOUR]

text: Evening. Oog hands you two sticks. Your turn to make fire.
scene: {CAVE} smiling, pointing at {GUY} confused in a cave, the word "FIRE" above them

text: You've seen this in movies. How hard can it be?
scene: {GUY} smug in a cave, the word "EASY" above him

text: Very hard.
scene: {SCI} smug at a chalkboard, the word "HARD" above him

text: Friction fire takes the right wood, the right technique, and a lot of practice.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "PRACTICE" above him

text: You rub. And rub.
scene: {GUY} sweating in a cave, the word "RUB" above him

text: Smoke? No.
scene: {GUY} sad in a cave, the word "SMOKE" above him, a big red X

text: Your arms burn. Your hands sweat. The stick slips.
scene: {GUY} sweating, hands on his head, in a cave, the word "SLIP" above him

text: Blisters? Yes.
scene: {GUY} sad, hands on his head, in a cave, the word "BLISTERS" above him

text: After forty minutes, Oog takes the sticks and makes fire in about a minute.
scene: {CAVE} smug by a campfire in a cave, sparkles

text: Timer: forty minutes. And a lot of shame.
scene: {GUY} sad by a campfire in a cave [TIMER 40 MIN]

text: Now imagine you're outside the cave at night. Alone.
scene: {GUY} terrified in the snow at night, the word "ALONE" above him

text: How cold was the Ice Age?
scene: {SCI} thinking at a chalkboard, a question mark

text: A 2020 study estimated that, on average, the whole planet was about six degrees Celsius colder than today.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "6 C" above him

text: That sounds small. It's not.
scene: {SCI} shocked at a chalkboard, an exclamation mark

text: In the far north, it was around fourteen degrees colder.
scene: {SCI} shocked at a chalkboard, the word "14 C" above him

text: And you're wearing a T-shirt.
scene: {GUY} terrified in the snow at night, the word "T SHIRT" above him

text: Oog is wearing furs, sewn together to keep the wind out.
scene: {CAVE} smug in the snow at night, the word "FURS" above him

text: You start shivering. Fast.
scene: {GUY} terrified, sweating, in the snow at night, the word "COLD" above him

text: Wind steals body heat, and wet clothes make it much worse.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "WIND" above him

text: The snow starts to fall. Your fingers stop listening to you.
scene: {GUY} terrified in the snow at night, the word "FINGERS" above him

text: Timer: twenty minutes, until Oog drags you back to the fire.
scene: {CAVE} proud next to {GUY} relieved by a campfire in a cave [TIMER 20 MIN]

text: Back at the fire, it's dinner time.
scene: {GUY} happy by a campfire in a cave, the word "DINNER" above him

text: Oog proudly hands you the best part of the animal.
scene: {CAVE} proud by a campfire in a cave, the word "BEST PART" above him

text: Not the steak. The bone marrow.
scene: {CAVE} happy by a campfire in a cave, the word "MARROW" above him

text: Archaeologists find animal bones at many old sites that were smashed open to get it out.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "SMASHED" above him

text: Marrow is rich in fat, and fat was precious in a cold world.
scene: {SCI} proud at a chalkboard, the word "FAT" above him

text: You take a bite.
scene: {GUY} confused by a campfire in a cave, a question mark

text: Your face does something you can't control.
scene: {GUY} disgusted by a campfire in a cave, an exclamation mark

text: Refusing a gift is rude in many cultures. Oog is offended.
scene: {CAVE} angry by a campfire in a cave, the word "RUDE" above him

text: Timer: ten minutes.
scene: {GUY} sad by a campfire in a cave [TIMER 10 MIN]

text: Quick scoreboard.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "SCORE" above him

text: The cave: all night. The walk: two hours. Berries: one hour.
scene: {SCI} proud at a chalkboard, the word "ALL NIGHT" above him

text: Fire: forty minutes. The cold: twenty minutes. Dinner: ten minutes.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "20 MIN" above him

text: And now it gets dangerous.
scene: {GUY} terrified in the snow, a big question mark

text: Another group appears on the hill.
scene: {GUY} shocked in the snow, three Neanderthals, an exclamation mark

text: You wave and say: "Hi, nice to meet you!"
scene: {GUY} happy, waving in the snow, the word "HI" above him

text: Nobody on Earth speaks English yet.
scene: {SCI} smug at a chalkboard, the word "ENGLISH" above him, a big red X

text: Not even close. Writing won't be invented for another thirty-five thousand years.
scene: a timeline, a stone tablet with "35000", the word "WRITING" above it

text: To them, you're a weird, soft stranger making strange sounds.
scene: three Neanderthals confused in the snow, a big question mark

text: Oog steps in, talks, and shares some meat.
scene: {CAVE} smiling next to a Neanderthal smiling in the snow, hearts

text: Sharing food was one of the oldest ways to say: we come in peace.
scene: {CAVE} happy and a Neanderthal happy by a campfire in the snow, the word "PEACE" above them

text: Timer: five minutes.
scene: {GUY} relieved in the snow [TIMER 5 MIN]

text: Next: a mammoth hunt.
scene: {GUY} shocked next to a mammoth in the snow, the word "HUNT" above him

text: A big woolly mammoth could weigh about six tonnes.
scene: a mammoth in the snow, a stone tablet with "6", the word "TONNES" above it

text: Hunters worked as a team, used the land, and picked their moment.
scene: {CAVE} thinking, holding a spear, in the snow, the word "TEAM" above him

text: You pick your moment too.
scene: {GUY} proud, holding a spear, in the snow, sparkles

text: The wrong one.
scene: {GUY} terrified next to a mammoth in the snow, an exclamation mark

text: You shout a battle cry you learned from a movie.
scene: {GUY} angry, shouting, holding a spear, in the snow, the word "CHARGE" above him

text: The mammoth turns around.
scene: a mammoth angry in the snow, {GUY} terrified

text: You run. Oog runs faster.
scene: {CAVE} smug and {GUY} terrified in the snow, the word "RUN" above them

text: Timer: two minutes.
scene: {GUY} sad in the snow, a mammoth [TIMER 2 MIN]

text: And finally, the shortest one.
scene: {GUY} confused in the snow, a big question mark

text: You go to the stream alone, to get water.
scene: {GUY} happy in the snow, the word "WATER" above him

text: Something moves in the grass.
scene: {GUY} shocked in the snow, an exclamation mark

text: A cave lion. Bigger than today's lions.
scene: {GUY} terrified, a lion angry in the snow, the word "BIGGER" above him

text: Your instinct says: run.
scene: {GUY} terrified in the snow, the word "RUN" above him

text: Bad idea.
scene: {SCI} shocked at a chalkboard, the word "BAD IDEA" above him

text: Running away can make a predator chase you.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "CHASE" above him

text: Usain Bolt's top speed was about forty-four kilometers an hour.
scene: {GUY} happy, arms in the air, on a savanna, the word "44 KMH" above him

text: A charging lion can hit around eighty.
scene: a lion angry on a savanna, the word "80 KMH" above it

text: And you are not Usain Bolt.
scene: {GUY} sad on a couch in a living room, the word "NOT BOLT" above him

text: Timer: four seconds.
scene: {GUY} terrified, a lion angry in the snow [TIMER 4 SEC]

text: So that's it. Four seconds. Game over?
scene: {GUY} sad in the snow, a big question mark

text: Not quite. Because you're not alone.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, next to {GUY} terrified, a lion angry in the snow

text: Oog's whole group shows up shouting, with spears and fire.
scene: {CAVE} angry, holding a torch, and a Neanderthal angry in the snow, a lion scared

text: The lion decides you're not worth it.
scene: a lion scared in the snow, the word "NOPE" above it

text: And here's the real twist.
scene: {SCI} thinking in a lab, a light bulb above him

text: Let's look at a real Neanderthal skeleton from Shanidar Cave in Iraq.
scene: {SCI} thinking at a microscope in a lab, the word "SHANIDAR" above him

text: Scientists call him Shanidar 1.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "SHANIDAR 1" above him

text: He had a crushing blow to the face that probably left him blind in one eye.
scene: {SCI} sad at a chalkboard, the word "BLIND" above him

text: His right arm was badly withered. He walked with a limp.
scene: a Neanderthal sad in a cave, the word "INJURED" above him

text: His bones show that those injuries healed,
scene: {SCI} shocked at a chalkboard, an exclamation mark

text: and he lived for years after them, into his late thirties or forties.
scene: a Neanderthal smiling by a campfire in a cave, hearts

text: Many researchers think he could hardly have survived that long without help from his group.
scene: {SCI} proud at a chalkboard, the word "HELP" above him

text: Someone shared food with him. Someone helped him move camp. Someone waited for him to catch up.
scene: a Neanderthal smiling and another Neanderthal happy in the snow, hearts

text: For years.
scene: a Neanderthal smiling by a campfire in a cave, hearts, sparkles

text: That's what kept people alive back then.
scene: {CAVE} smiling, a Neanderthal happy and {WOMAN} smiling by a campfire in a cave, hearts

text: Not big muscles. Not sharp spears.
scene: {CAVE} smiling, holding a spear, a big red X

text: Each other.
scene: {CAVE} and {GUY} and {WOMAN} smiling by a campfire in a cave, hearts, sparkles

text: So if Oog's group takes you in,
scene: {CAVE} happy next to {GUY} smiling by a campfire in a cave, hearts

text: your timer says: forever.
scene: {GUY} happy by a campfire in a cave, hearts, sparkles [TIMER FOREVER]

text: So how long would you really last in Oog's world?
scene: {GUY} thinking in a cave, a big question mark

text: Alone? About four seconds.
scene: {GUY} terrified, a lion angry in the snow [TIMER 4 SEC]

text: With friends? Long enough to become the best fire maker in the cave.
scene: {GUY} proud by a campfire in a cave, sparkles, the word "FIRE MAKER" above him

text: Which, given those blisters, might take a while.
scene: {GUY} sad, hands on his head, in a cave, the word "BLISTERS" above him

text: Oog will wait. He's very patient. He's had forty thousand years of practice.
scene: {CAVE} smug by a campfire in a cave, the word "PATIENT" above him

text: Tell us in the comments: which part would you fail first?
scene: {GUY} thinking in a living room, a question mark

text: The berries, the fire, or the lion?
scene: {CAVE} smug in a cave, the word "WHICH ONE" above him [TIMER ?]

text: If you liked this series, subscribe: Oog has a lot more places to visit.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, in a city street, sparkles, the word "SUBSCRIBE" above him
